decisions.reason: The construction site dumper was only mentioned on the website and fits less with the lift lines, so its withdrawal risk is higher, but it still uses the firm's vehicle know-how and is kept for now.
The inclined furniture lift line was presented on its own page and serves a steady market for movers and craftsmen, which suits the firm's lifting and service strengths.
The inclined building material lift line shares its platform with the furniture lifts and serves construction demand, so keeping it is efficient.
The truck-mounted furniture lift complements the lift family and serves a niche of professional users, so it is kept despite its somewhat smaller market.
